title: Waffle Maker Hash Browns
description: The crispiest hash browns you'll ever make — squeezed dry, pressed into a hot waffle iron with onion for perfect results.
steps: Peel potatoes; grate into a bowl of water (to prevent browning).
Rinse; transfer to a tea towel; squeeze as much water out as possible.
Season with salt and pepper; mix.
Preheat waffle iron; oil both plates.
Add 10g onion, then 100g potatoes; close and press down until sizzling. Cook 2 min; press again; cook 6–8 more minutes.
notes: Add garlic, rosemary or other spices for more flavour. Squeezing the water is the most important step.
